stages.name: Get found
stages.ideal: Every service line has a campaign in market and a page that sounds like the clinic, and every dollar is attributed without sending health data to an ad platform.

leaks.name: The Invisible Clinic
leaks.description: You never show up at the search

stages.nostat: No benchmark we trust yet for how many patients never find a clinic. GrowthOS attribution data can produce one.

features.name: Campaign engine
features.description: One brief in; landing page, Google and Meta ads, email, SMS and WhatsApp out, in the clinic's own voice.

features.name: Ads Manager and AI Ad Optimizer
features.description: Google and Meta campaigns with wasted-spend detection and fixes you approve.

features.name: Landing pages
features.description: Service pages in the clinic's colors and voice, on its own domain, edited by chatting with them.

features.name: Quiz funnels
features.description: Candidacy quizzes that give the patient a useful answer and sort every lead hot, warm or cold into the right stage and follow up.

features.name: Events
features.description: Seminars, open houses and webinars with registration, reminders and attendance, rolling to the next date on their own.

features.name: Website management and SEO
features.description: Page edits, new pages, and compliance monitoring on the clinic's own site.

features.name: Doctor referral campaigns
features.description: Referring doctors send patients in; the doctor is thanked and optionally nurtured.

features.name: Server-side conversion tracking
features.description: Every lead attributed to the click that earned it, with nothing identifying sent to ad platforms.

stages.patient_says: I'm comparing clinics at 11pm and reading everything.

stages.name: First response
stages.ideal: Every inquiry answered in under 60 seconds, on the channel the patient chose, at any hour.

leaks.name: The 13-Hour Patient
leaks.description: First reply comes far too late

stats.label: average wait before a human responds to a new lead
the window to respond before a lead goes cold

features.name: Website lead sources
features.description: The forms already on the clinic's website send every inquiry into GrowthOS, so follow up starts on day one.

features.name: AI front desk
features.description: Answers web chat, SMS, email, WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram in seconds, day or night, trained on the clinic.

features.name: Voice AI
features.description: Answers and books phone calls 24/7, included on every plan.

features.name: Phone trees
features.description: The clinic designs its own call flow: greeting, menu, business-hours routing, and where every call ends up.

features.name: Call intelligence
features.description: Every recorded call transcribed and analyzed: new patient or not, what they asked about, whether they booked, and why not.

features.name: Forms and lead scoring
features.description: Every submission becomes a contact, a deal and a sequence the moment it lands, and can be qualified red, yellow or green with its own rules or the Qualification Agent's.

features.name: AI lead discovery
features.description: Finds patient inquiries sitting in the clinic's Gmail and puts them in the pipeline.

stages.patient_says: I filled out the form. Is anyone there?

stages.name: Nurture and qualify
stages.ideal: Every lead is qualified with the clinic's own questions, on forms and in chat, and every lead has an owner, a next step and a message written for where they are. Dormant lists get worked, not deleted.

stats.label: of inquiries never reach a booked consult

metrics: Leads qualified green, yellow or red

features.name: Email and SMS sequences
features.description: Written for the stage the patient is in, and stopped the moment they reply or book.

features.name: Qualification Agent
features.description: Every account has one, blank and switched off until the clinic names it, adds its own questions and red and yellow rules, and turns it on. The same questions and rules can run on forms.

features.name: Unified inbox with contact owners
features.description: One thread per patient across every channel, an owner on every lead, and team chat beside it.

features.name: Follow-up reminders
features.description: Surfaces every patient who has gone too long without a contact, by pipeline stage.

features.name: Reactivation campaigns
features.description: Works the dormant list the clinic already paid for, once, on purpose.

features.name: Newsletters
features.description: Drag-and-drop email to the whole list, with unsubscribe and consent enforced.

features.name: Workflows and automations
features.description: Trigger-based workflows with branches that send, tag, move, enroll, book and alert, so repeatable steps stop depending on memory.

stages.patient_says: I'm not ready yet. Don't forget me, and don't spam me.

stages.name: Book and show up
stages.ideal: Booking takes one conversation, every appointment gets reminders on the patient's channel, and nobody arrives as a stranger.

stats.label: average relative drop in missed appointments when phone or SMS reminders are sent (29 studies)

features.name: Booking and appointment automations
features.description: Self-serve scheduling, reminders on every channel, and follow-up when someone does not show.

features.name: Consult Booking Agent
features.description: Checks real availability, books, and writes it back to the calendar and the EHR.

features.name: Patient Onboarding Agent
features.description: A pre-visit message written to what that patient actually said.

features.name: Patient Waiting Room
features.description: Patients see their place in line and their wait on their own phone.

features.name: Telehealth and virtual visits
features.description: Video consults with transcription, inside the same record.

features.name: Cross-location recognition
features.description: A patient who contacts the wrong location is recognized, and the right team is alerted.

stages.patient_says: Let me pick a time, and remind me.

stages.name: Consult to commitment
stages.ideal: Nobody leaves a consult without a next step. Consent is done before the visit, and a stalled decision is flagged before it goes cold.

leaks.name: The Money Stall
leaks.description: Cost and financing stall the yes

stats.label: of the reasons patients give for stopping fertility treatment are postponement (22 studies, 21,453 patients)

features.name: Pipelines with leak stages
features.description: Every stalled decision flagged by stage, with the clinic's own playbook for each one.

features.name: Consent and education
features.description: Multi-party consent with the education video, finished on a phone before the visit.

features.name: ChartAI records retrieval
features.description: Outside medical records requested and organized before the consult.

features.name: Billing automation
features.description: A pipeline stage sends the invoice or payment link by email and SMS the moment a patient enters it, and the payment lands on the same record.

stages.patient_says: I understand the plan. Now I have to decide, and pay.

stages.name: In treatment
stages.ideal: No cycle-timed test is missed, and every escalation reaches a person with context in minutes.

stats.label: of the reasons patients give for stopping are organizational or clinic problems

features.name: Cycle Coordinator
features.description: Projects when each cycle-timed test is due, books it inside its window, and confirms dates with the patient.

features.name: Crisis Triage Agent
features.description: Builds a one-page briefing from the patient's history and pages staff. It never gives clinical advice.

features.name: EHR integrations
features.description: Appointments and records kept in sync with the clinic's existing system.

features.name: GrowthOS mobile app
features.description: Staff answer patients from their phone, with the full thread and chart context.

stages.patient_says: This is hard. I need to know what happens next.

stages.name: After the cycle
stages.ideal: Every stored specimen has an owner, a renewal date, and a patient who heard from the clinic this year.

leaks.name: The Full Tank
leaks.description: Eggs and embryos stored, patient gone quiet

stats.label: of US fresh IVF cycles that froze embryos never had a later frozen transfer
of egg-freezing patients came back to use their eggs within 5 to 7 years
of patients with stored embryos report high conflict over what to do with them

features.name: Cryo ledger
features.description: Eggs or embryos, storage date, consent renewal and fee status for every patient, synced from the lab system and never replacing it.

features.name: Storage and return outreach
features.description: Anniversaries, renewal deadlines and return-for-transfer nudges. Paused after a known loss, handed to a person when it matters.

features.name: Disposition decision support
features.description: Plain-language options, a counselor one tap away, every answer recorded against the consent on file.

features.name: Research log and Leakage Index
features.description: Time to reply, time to return and which message worked, benchmarked across clinics and structured for publication.

stages.patient_says: I have embryos frozen. I'm not ready to decide.

stages.name: Advocate and return
stages.ideal: Every good outcome gets a review ask at the right moment, every referrer is thanked, and alumni hear from the clinic.
stages.nostat: No benchmark we trust yet for alumni referral or return rates. The Patient Continuity research log is built to measure it.

features.name: Google reviews and replies
features.description: Import every review and answer it with an AI draft the clinic approves.

features.name: Review requests from pipeline stages
features.description: The clinic picks the stage that sends the review link, what it says, and when it resends.

features.name: Referral asks and doctor thank-yous
features.description: Patients and referring doctors are thanked and asked at the right moment.

features.name: Alumni journeys and retargeting
features.description: Outcome-aware re-engagement, so a graduate hears from the clinic without a sales pitch.

features.name: Newsletters to alumni
features.description: The same drag-and-drop newsletters keep graduates close to the clinic between visits.

stages.patient_says: They were there for me. I'll tell people.

Qualification Agent in Nurture and qualify is now in every account, blank until the clinic names it and sets it up.
Added Call intelligence to First response.
Renamed Landing pages and quiz funnels to Landing pages in Get found.
Renamed Phone trees and call intelligence to Phone trees in First response.
Added Quiz funnels to Get found.
Added Workflows and automations to Nurture and qualify.
Added Website lead sources to First response.
Added billing automation to Consult to commitment and newsletters to Advocate and return.
First version. Eight stages, the nine leaks from The Seven-Figure Leak plus a tenth (The Full Tank), and Patient Continuity for the after-the-cycle stage.

foundation.name: BAA with the contract
foundation.description: Signed in the same package as the services agreement; PHI encrypted at rest and isolated per clinic.

foundation.name: GDPR and UK GDPR
foundation.description: DPA, sub-processor register, breach notice and patient data rights handled in the platform.

foundation.name: EHR and CRM integrations
foundation.description: Fertility EHRs and Salesforce kept in sync, so staff work in one place.

foundation.name: Network and multi-location
foundation.description: Every location reports against the same definitions; records stay separate.

foundation.name: The scorecard
foundation.description: The clinic's own stages and targets, graded green or red every morning.

foundation.name: Server-side attribution
foundation.description: Our own conversion pipeline; nothing identifying leaves for an ad platform.

foundation.name: Consent and opt-out enforced
foundation.description: Every channel checks consent and unsubscribe before it sends.

foundation.name: Agents under control
foundation.description: The clinic decides which agents run and what they touch; every run is logged.
